Yes, that’s the right order ID. Please cancel it because I no longer need it.

Thanks for taking care of that. I also need to cancel the boot and the kettle I ordered. Can you help with that next?
That’s the right order ID. Please cancel both because I don’t need them anymore.
Thanks for your help. One last thing—I’d like to return the sneaker I got. Can you help me with that?
Yes, that’s the right order ID. I just want to return the sneakers, and please refund it to my gift card.
Yes, please go ahead and process the return.
Thank you for your help with everything today. That’s all I needed. ###STOP###
